snippet.title: The ATO’s 2027 Tax Rules Are Here — Australians Born in the 40s, 50s & 60s Will Pay More?
snippet.description:
📘 FREE GUIDE: 10 Things Australian Retirees Are Owed
👉 https://andrewcoburnexplains.com/guide

Ten entitlements, tax offsets and concession cards that many Australians in or near retirement miss, from the Seniors and Pensioners Tax Offset to the Commonwealth Seniors Health Card. What each one is worth, who usually qualifies, and the call that gets it moving. Plain English, every figure checked against the ATO and Services Australia. Free, straight to your inbox. 📩

· · ·

If you were born before 1965, the tax rules for 2027 are now law. And two of them could land on you harder than on almost anyone else.

For close to thirty years, only half the gain was taxed when you sold shares or an investment property you'd held for more than a year. From 1 July 2027, that changes for any growth from that date on. And assets bought before 20 September 1985, which have sat outside capital gains tax for more than forty years, lose that protection for future growth too.

😂 En ruso, el número 2 tiene su versión femenina!
Два студента… но две студентки. ✊👑

Está ganando el matriarcado???? 🤣

Mmmmm… A ver… 🤔

En las antiguas lenguas eslavas existía una categoría gramatical llamada número dual, que se utilizaba para hablar de dos personas o cosas. El número dos tenía formas diferentes según el género gramatical: masculino y neutro дъва, femenino двѣ.

Aunque el ruso perdió el número dual como categoría gramatical independiente, conservó esta distinción hasta nuestros días: два y две.

¿En tu idioma también existen curiosidades gramaticales así? ❤️

snippet.title: How to make a very crunchy chicken sandwich with @RedRockDeliAustralia Nashville Hot Chicken chips
snippet.description:
Nashville Hot Chicken sandwich

Ingredients
1 Packet Nashville Hot Chicken Red Rock Deli chips
6 boneless, skinless chicken thighs 
1 tbsp salt 
2 tbsp ground black pepper 
2 tbsp garlic powder 
2 tbsp cayenne powder (more if you want it spicier)
12g  brown sugar
600ml  buttermilk
40ml hot sauce (vinegar-based)
2 eggs
200g lard/beef tallow/rendered bacon fat
260g all purpose flour
3L peanut oil for frying
6 milk buns 
1/2 cup mayonnaise 
Pickles to serve 

Method
Buttermilk marinade:  Mix 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp ground black pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder and 1 tsp cayenne pepper.

Flour spice mix:  Mix 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder and 1 tsp cayenne pepper.

Spicy oil mix: Mix 8 tsp cayenne pepper, 3 tsp brown sugar, 3 tsp ground black pepper and 3 tsp smoked paprika.

Hot chicken
In a large bowl, mix the buttermilk, hot sauce, 200ml water, eggs, and the buttermilk marinade. Add chicken and refrigerate for 12-24 hours.

Crunch 100g of chips and mix into the flour. Add flour spice mix. Remove marinated chicken from the buttermilk, coat well in the seasoned flour and leave for 20 mins to hydrate.

Preheat your oil to 140°C (284°F). Cook chicken in small batches to avoid overcrowding. Cook for 6-7 mins, then remove and place onto a wire rack to cool for 20 mins.

Heat the lard in a small pot to 160°C (320°F). Place the spicy oil mix in a heatproof bowl. Carefully pour hot lard over the spices, stir well, and keep nearby for when your chicken comes out of the fryer.

Increase the oil temp to 165°C (329°F) and continue to cook your chicken for 4-5 mins or until golden brown. Remove from the oil, place onto a wire rack, and immediately brush liberally with spicy oil.

To serve, spread mayonnaise on each half of the milk buns. Toast on a hot pan until golden brown. Top each half of the bun with more mayonnaise, one piece of fried chicken each, divide the remaining Nashville Hot Chicken chips between each burger and top with pickles. Fit the top bun and enjoy.

snippet.title: ¿Por qué ODIAS tu voz en los audios? 😬 Así te escuchan todos
snippet.description:
Cuando hablas, te escuchas por dos caminos: por el aire y por dentro, a través de los huesos de tu cabeza (conducción ósea). Los huesos refuerzan los tonos graves, así que en tu cabeza suenas más grave. El celular solo graba lo que viaja por el aire, que es lo mismo que escuchan los demás. Por eso tu voz grabada te suena rara… pero es tu voz real.

Ojo: en el estudio de 2013, las personas calificaron su propia voz como más atractiva que como la calificaron los demás, y la mayoría no se dio cuenta de que era la suya.

Fuentes:
- Reinfeldt y otros (2010), Journal of the Acoustical Society of America: cómo escuchamos nuestra propia voz por aire y por hueso.
- Hughes y Harrison (2013), Perception: "I like my voice better".

Sigue a Kova para entender cómo funcionan las cosas.

snippet.title: Ali'den Zeynep'e İddialı Sözler! - Anne Yarısı 8. Bölüm (SON SAHNE)
snippet.description:
Ali, Zeynep'i şaşırtan şeyler söyledi. ÇÜNKÜ BANA AŞIK OLACAKSIN!
Anne Yarısı 8. Bölümü izlemek için tıklayın: https://youtu.be/fd76r3TnXwk

(17 Kasım 2026)

Ali, Zeynep’in haberi olmadan onunla evlenme işini halletmiş, böylece hem kızından koparılmamış hem de annesinin hapishaneye girme ihtimalini ortadan kaldırmıştır. Durumu öğrenen Zeynep çok sinirlenir ve nikahı iptal ettirmek üzere harekete geçer. Ancak Ali onun da önlemini almıştır. Zeynep’i iki gün zorla bir bağ evinde tutarak iptalin önünü alır. Zeynep ve Ali’nin evliliğini konaktakilere açıklama görevi ise Meryem’e düşer. Duruma en çok sevinen ise Ege olacaktır. Bu haberi Ege’den öğrenen Bayındır ailesinde ise tam bir şok yaşanır. Altın kendi oğlu kurtuldu diye sevinirken Kadir karaları bağlar. Sibel’in şantajından kurtulmak için karısının altınlarını çalıp ona veren Asım’ın başı belaya girer. Sibel hırsızlıkla suçlanınca gerçekleri söyler, böylece Asım ve Songül konaktan kovulurlar. Nazlı ve Özcan ilişkisi Altın yüzünden zor günler geçiriyordur. Nazlı, Altın’dan kurtulmak için büyük bir hamle yapar. İki gün baş başa kalmak Zeynep ve Ali’yi iyice birbirlerine yaklaştıracaktır.

Sekiz yıl önce yaşanan büyük bir kaybın ardından yolları aynı çocuğun etrafında kesişen Ali ve Zeynep’in duygu yüklü hikayesini ekrana taşıyacak. Geçmişin sırları, velayet mücadelesi ve büyük fedakarlıklarla örülen dizi, izleyiciyi etkileyici bir yolculuğa çıkaracak.

snippet.title: VECINOS CAPTURAN Y ENTREGAN A DOS PRESUNTOS LADRONES TRAS ESPERAR EN VANO A CARABINEROS EN CHONCHI
snippet.description:
¡Indignación y hartazgo ciudadano en Chiloé! 📉🚨 Cansados de la tardanza policial ante la delincuencia, un grupo de vecinos de Chonchi decidió tomar la justicia en sus propias manos al lograr la captura de dos presuntos antisociales acusados de robo, en un impactante episodio que quedó grabado y rápidamente viralizado en redes sociales gracias al registro difundido por @chiloenews.

Según los antecedentes dados a conocer, los civiles persiguieron y detuvieron por sus propios medios a los sujetos durante la noche del pasado miércoles 11 de noviembre, trasladándolos directamente hasta las puertas de la Tenencia de Chonchi para entregarlos a los funcionarios de guardia. En el video, uno de los vecinos increpa sin filtro a los detenidos señalando: “Esto solamente pasa en Chonchi. Nosotros tuvimos que seguirlos, detenerlos nosotros mismos... más encima tan hueones, habiendo cámaras en toda la cuadra, se ponen a ir a robar ahí al lado”.

El capitán Felipe San Martín Lagos, de la Segunda Comisaría de Castro, confirmó el procedimiento tras recibir a los individuos en el marco de una detención ciudadana por delito flagrante. Posteriormente, los involucrados fueron trasladados hasta Castro para su respectivo control de detención en el Juzgado de Garantía. Si bien la legislación chilena faculta a los ciudadanos para retener a delincuentes en flagrancia, desde Carabineros reiteraron el llamado urgente a la comunidad a evitar exponerse a situaciones de riesgo y a privilegiar el uso del nivel de emergencia 133. 🏛️👮‍♂️⚠️

snippet.title: Plastic Bottles + Old Tire = Gold Column Planter ✨
snippet.description:
Learn how to make a DIY concrete column tire planter with gold spiral stripes, built on an old car tire and cast in plastic bottles. The result is an elegant round garden planter that looks like a classic pillar ring.

Concrete is poured into plastic bottles to cast spiral-grooved columns, which are then demolded and stood in a ring on a concrete-filled tire base. Once cured, the whole planter is painted white and finished with gold spiral stripes and bands, then filled with soil and planted with bougainvillea. It is a cheap, creative way to turn recycled materials into a stunning garden centerpiece. Subscribe to Soil & Soul for more DIY garden projects.

0:00 Casting concrete columns in plastic bottles
0:13 Pouring the tire base and setting the columns
0:24 Curing, painting white and adding gold

• Funnel
• Rubber mallet
• Metal rods
• Trowel
• Wooden braces and clamps
• Plastic sheeting
• White paint
• Gold paint
• Paintbrush
• Bougainvillea and soil

ประวัติศาสตร์รัฐไทย 5000 ปี https://youtu.be/15sToKcUobI?si=edCBEZyHNO-H5_ZW 
บ้านพลูหลวง ราชวงศ์ต้องสาป https://youtu.be/a-IyzVLwx2U?si=5dtIawBGKllVrA2M 

อ้างอิง 
กาญจนศิลป์ ณ. (2018). ฐานทัพอเมริกันกับการเติบโตทางเศรษฐกิจของนครราชสีมา. วารสารวิจัยราชภัฏกรุงเก่า สาขามนุษยศาสตร์และสังคมศาสตร์, 5(3), 103–112. สืบค้น จาก https://so01.tci-thaijo.org/index.php/rdi-aru/article/view/212989 

กำพล จำปาพันธ์. (2568, 27 กุมภาพันธ์). 'โนนพลล้าน' กับโฉมหน้าประวัติศาสตร์ใหม่ของนครราชสีมา. The People. https://www.thepeople.co/history/nostalgia/54754 

พีรภัทร ฉัตรพิบูลย์ภูเวียง ห้าวเหิม, วีระนุช แย้มยิ้ม, ยิ่งศักดิ์ คชโคตร, อุเทณ วัชรชิโณรส, และ เศรษฐศาสตร์ วัตรโศก. (2568). การรื้อสร้างโครงสร้างอำนาจรัฐจารีต: บทวิเคราะห์เชิงวิพากษ์ว่าด้วยสถานะของนครราชสีมาในระบบปริมณฑลอำนาจอยุธยาถึงรัตนโกสินทร์ตอนต้น. วารสารวิชาการ, ฉบับที่ 2, 1–35. https://so02.tci-thaijo.org/index.php/jas/article/view/281986 

สำนักงานบริหารและพัฒนาองค์ความรู้ (องค์การมหาชน). (2569, 23 เมษายน). ก่อนจะมาเป็น “นครราชสีมา” พื้นที่ที่เปลี่ยนชื่อ เปลี่ยนศูนย์กลาง และเปลี่ยนความหมายตามกาลเวลา. OKMD Knowledge Portal. https://knowledgeportal.okmd.or.th/kmap/69e98e9adc990 

สำนักศิลปะและวัฒนธรรม มหาวิทยาลัยราชภัฏนครราชสีมา. (ม.ป.ป.). พิพิธภัณฑ์เมืองนครราชสีมา (Korat Museum). มหาวิทยาลัยราชภัฏนครราชสีมา. https://www.koratmuseum.com/download/broshure-korat-museum.pdf 

สุจิตต์ วงษ์เทศ. (2567, 25 กรกฎาคม). โลกล้านปีที่โคราช ประวัติศาสตร์สยาม ต้นทางความเป็นไทย. มติชนออนไลน์. https://www.matichon.co.th/prachachuen/news_4696389
